structured.reason: The mutant decides whether to run local tools based on tool_choice instead of whether a tool registry exists. A request that has a registry but no explicit tool_choice would return the raw tool calls straight away, with no tool execution and no follow-up turn. That breaks multi-round execution.
sources: Supported provider routes shall be able to execute a multi-step local-tool workflow and feed tool results back into subsequent provider turns until a final response is produced.
OpenAI-compatible executes add then multiply, round-trips each tool result, and terminates with final result 84.
structured.test_focus: With a tool registry present and tool_choice left as None, an OpenAI-compatible add-then-multiply workflow must still run both tools, send each result back to the provider, and finish with 84.
